findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_event_contact, get_event_join_details · Private data: get_event_contact, get_not_listed_event, request_event_correction, submit_event · Public sink: get_event_contact, request_event_correction, submit_event · Destructive: list_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_event_contact, get_event_join_details · Private data: get_event_contact, get_not_listed_event, request_event_correction, submit_event · Public sink: get_event_contact, request_event_correction, submit_event · Destructive: list_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
